conventions.hamiltonian: H=i^(q/2) sum J_ijkl chi_i chi_j chi_k chi_l, q=4
conventions.limit_scope: no finite-N permanence claim; compare only structurally to large-C-first EFT
conventions.majoranas: {chi_i,chi_j}=delta_ij; JW Clifford on Nm/2 qubits per dot
conventions.pulse_operator: fixed seed-derived random Hermitian bilinear, operator norm one
conventions.synchronization: single u_*=1 at pulse end; no later resynchronization
conventions.window: T in [1.5,5] J^-1 after support [0,1]; short diagnostic, recurrences not excluded
